easy.def: To pull something along the ground.
examples: Drag the box.
He dragged his bag.
The dog drags the toy.

more.def: To pull something heavy along the ground.
examples: They dragged the heavy sled up the hill.
He dragged his suitcase across the floor.
The dog dragged a stick through the yard.

easy.def: A big make-believe animal with wings that breathes fire.
examples: The dragon flew over the castle.
We read a book about a dragon.
The dragon had green scales.

more.def: A make-believe animal in stories that looks like a giant lizard with wings and can breathe fire.
examples: The knight in the story fought a fierce dragon.
In many tales, a dragon guards a pile of gold.
He drew a dragon with red wings and sharp claws.

easy.def: To make a picture with a pencil or crayon.
examples: I draw a cat.
She drew a house.
He draws with chalk.

more.def: To make a picture or design with a pencil, pen or crayon.
examples: She drew a map of the island.
He likes to draw cartoons.
We drew pictures of our pets.

easy.def: To pull something toward you.
examples: Draw the rope toward you.
The magnet draws the nails.
He drew the bow.

more.def: To pull something toward you or along.
examples: Horses drew the wagon down the road.
Draw the curtains at night.
A magnet draws small nails to it.

easy.def: Pictures and stories in your mind while you sleep.
examples: I had a dream.
The dream was funny.
She told me her dream.

more.def: Thoughts and pictures that go through your mind while you are asleep.
examples: I had a dream that I could fly over the town.
He woke up from a strange dream about a talking cat.
Dreams can be silly, happy, or scary.

easy.def: Something you really want to do or be.
examples: My dream is to be a pilot.
Her dream came true.
He has a big dream.

more.def: Something you hope for very much and want to achieve.
examples: Her dream is to be an astronaut one day.
He worked hard to make his dream come true.
It is my dream to visit the Arctic.

easy.def: To see pictures in your mind while you sleep.
examples: I dream at night.
She dreamed of a cat.
He is dreaming.

more.def: To have thoughts and pictures in your mind while sleeping, or to imagine something you wish for.
examples: The puppy twitched its paws as if it were dreaming of a run.
I dreamed that I was swimming with dolphins.
She dreams of being a famous singer.

easy.def: A piece of clothing with a top and skirt joined together.
examples: She wore a yellow dress.
My dress has pockets.
I put on a dress for the party.

more.def: A piece of clothing that covers the top of the body and hangs down over the legs.
examples: She twirled in her new red dress.
The dress had flowers stitched along the bottom.
Grandma wore a blue dress to the concert.

easy.def: To put clothes on.
examples: I dress myself.
Mom dressed the baby.
Dress warmly today.

more.def: To put clothes on yourself or someone else.
examples: Dress warmly because it is snowing outside.
The twins dressed as pirates for the school party.
It takes the toddler a long time to dress.

easy.def: To take milk or water into your mouth and swallow.
examples: I drink milk.
The dog drank water.
Drink your juice.

more.def: To take a liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
examples: Camels can drink a lot of water at one time.
I drink a glass of milk every morning.
The baby bird drank water from the dish.

easy.def: Milk, juice, or water in a cup.
examples: I want a drink.
Milk is a drink.
She gave me a drink.

more.def: A liquid that people swallow when thirsty, or one gulp of it.
examples: The waiter brought each of us a cold drink.
Orange juice is my favorite morning drink.
He took a long drink of water after the race.

easy.def: To make a car or truck go.
examples: Dad drives a truck.
She drove us home.
I will drive the bus.

more.def: To control a car, truck, or bus as it moves along.
examples: My mom drives me to school every morning.
The bus driver drove slowly on the snowy road.
He is learning to drive a tractor on the farm.

easy.def: A trip in a car.
examples: We went for a drive.
It is a long drive.
The drive was fun.

more.def: A trip in a car or other vehicle.
examples: The drive to the beach takes about two hours.
We took a scenic drive through the mountains.
It was a short drive from the airport.

easy.def: A person who drives a car, bus or truck.
examples: The bus driver waved to us.
My mom is a good driver.
The driver stopped at the red light.

more.def: A person whose job or task is to drive a vehicle.
examples: The bus driver greets every child by name.
A race car driver must react very fast.
The truck driver delivered boxes of apples.

easy.def: To let something fall.
examples: Do not drop it.
She dropped her cup.
The leaf will drop.

more.def: To let something fall, or to fall down.
examples: Be careful not to drop the eggs on the floor.
The apple dropped from the tree with a thud.
The temperature drops at night in the desert.

easy.def: A tiny round bit of water.
examples: A drop of rain fell.
I felt a drop.
Add one drop.

more.def: A very small amount of liquid in a rounded shape.
examples: A drop of rain landed on my nose.
Add one drop of food coloring to the water.
Dew drops sparkled on the spider web.

related.def: A small tube that lets out one drop at a time.

easy.def: A long time with no rain.
examples: The plants died in the drought.
The pond dried up in the drought.
There was no water to spare in the drought.

more.def: A long period with little or no rain, so the land becomes very dry.
examples: During the drought, the farmers' fields turned brown.
After the long drought, the river was only a trickle.
The town asked people to save water during the drought.

easy.def: To die because you are in water and cannot breathe.
examples: The lifeguard watches so no one will drown.
A tiny ant almost drowned in a puddle.
The sailors were saved before they could drown.

more.def: To die by breathing in water because you cannot get air.
examples: Lifeguards are trained to rescue swimmers who might drown.
The little mouse nearly drowned when it fell in the rain barrel.
The sailors wore life jackets, so they did not drown when the boat tipped.

easy.def: Medicine that helps you get well.
examples: The doctor gave me a drug for my cough.
This drug helps with pain.
A grown-up must give you a drug.

more.def: A medicine used to treat an illness or pain.
examples: The doctor prescribed a drug to fight the infection.
Scientists are testing a new drug for allergies.
Some drugs come as pills and others as liquids.

easy.def: Not wet.
examples: The towel is dry.
My hair is dry.
The ground is dry.

more.def: Not wet, with no water on it.
examples: The towel was dry by the afternoon.
The dry ground was cracked.
Desert plants live where it is dry.

easy.def: To take away water.
examples: Dry your hands.
The sun dries the clothes.
I dried the dishes.

more.def: To take water away from something, or to lose its water.
examples: Dry your hands on the towel.
The sun dried the laundry on the line.
I dried the dishes after dinner.
